name: Mathematical Programming
description: Modeling with linear programming (LP) and applications, polyhedral theory and geometry of LPs, simplex method, revised simplex method, LP duality, domplementary slackness, Farkas' lemma, sensitivity analysis. Nonlinear programming - unconstrained optimization, iterative descent, constrained optimization, KKT conditions, introduction to integer programming, dynamic programming, network optimization.
